{{Wireless adapter |brand=Xfinity |model=XW2 |revision=(PXW02ABA) |fcc_date=08/26/2015 |is_manuf=No |manuf=Pegatron |manuf_model=PXW02ABA |if=USB |if_bus_version=3.0 |if_connector_type=Male A |form_factor=hinged dongle |fcc_id=VUI-PXW02ABA |chip1_brand=Realtek |chip1_model=RTL8812AU;RTL8812AU, ECP16P5 GF09; |accessible_UART=No |flags=DFS (slave), |802dot11_protocols=abgn+ac |txchains=2 |rxchains=2 |sstreams=2 }} {{TagLine|802.11ac WiFi Adapter for IP Client Set-Top Box}} {{See also|Comcast Xfinity KXW02AAA|Xfinity XW4}} The User Manual at the FCC says, "Your PXW02ABA USB WiFi adapter is designed to work with a Pace PX032ANI set-top box.
